Deploy your own production-ready Jenkins in AWS ECS
latest.description: This article walks through deploying a production-ready Jenkins platform on AWS ECS using Fargate and CloudFormation. It covers Jenkins architecture, ECS design choices, secure ingress with ALB, persistent storage using Amazon EFS, and automated recovery across Availability Zones—helping you build a resilient, secure, and cloud-native CI/CD setup suitable for real-world workloads.

latest.title: AWS EKS Auto Mode
latest.description: AWS EKS Auto Mode delivers a fully managed, production-ready Kubernetes environment by automating compute, scaling, networking, and node lifecycle operations. It simplifies cluster management, enhances security, optimizes costs, and reduces operational burden—letting teams focus on applications while AWS handles the infrastructure.

latest.title: Deploying SonarQube on AWS Using ECS Fargate, AWS EFS, RDS PostgreSQL and AWS CloudFormation (IaC)
latest.description: SonarQube on AWS delivers a scalable, secure, and fully automated code-quality platform using ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, and EFS. With CloudFormation, the entire architecture becomes reproducible and consistent across environments, providing a resilient, serverless deployment that simplifies operations while supporting modern DevSecOps practices.

latest.title: Production AWS Web App with CDK: Fargate, Aurora, CloudFront and the Quiet Failures Nobody Warns You About
latest.description: Most CDK tutorials stop at "it deployed." This walks through the full production stack - VPC tiers, Fargate on private subnets, Aurora with KMS encryption, Secrets Manager rotation, CloudFront with OAC - and the silent failure modes that wake you up at 2 AM. Includes a real cost breakdown, the NAT Gateway trap, and what I would do differently next time.

latest.title: 🚀 Getting Started with AWS Lambda: Build Your First Serverless Project
latest.description: In this article, I’ll walk through what Lambda is, why it’s useful, and how you can build a simple project to get started.

latest.title: The Architecture Review Board Is Not What It Used To Be
latest.description: AI-driven development is breaking the traditional Architecture Review Board. The fix is not to slow AI down or give up on EA. It is to turn architectural intent into executable artefacts: fitness functions, tiered AI review, and AGENTS.md treated as a runtime spec, not documentation.

latest.title: AI Coaching Notes + Video Sync with AWS (PlayTicks)
latest.description: PlayTicks is a real-time soccer coaching annotation tool that converts short voice notes into structured match events. Built with Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon ECS, it automatically transcribes and classifies coaching notes and syncs them to game timestamps for faster post-game video review.

latest.title: Minha primeira aplicação na nuvem: o que aprendi hospedando um sistema real na AWS
latest.description: Construir um sistema na faculdade é uma coisa. Colocar um sistema real no ar, com usuários de verdade, é outra bem diferente. Neste artigo, compartilho os desafios, erros e aprendizados que tive ao hospedar minha primeira aplicação na AWS — um sistema de gestão para clínicas de estética. Das dores de configuração ao medo da fatura no fim do mês, passando pelo papel da IA como aliada nos momentos de travamento. Um relato sincero sobre o que a faculdade não ensina, mas a prática entrega.
